svg.title: How the apply job decides whether a text of the answer holds a secret
svg.desc: A known kind of token refuses the answer wherever it is. Any other text is looked at in runs of 40 or more letters, digits and the characters plus, slash, equals sign, underscore and dash, after the owner, the repository and the commit or branch of every link to GitHub are left out, unless the name of the repository or the branch has 32 or more characters. A run without lower case, upper case and digits is harmless. A run with the plus or equals sign of Base64, or whose letters read like noise, is a key, unless it is part of the path of a file that git tracks. Any other run is harmless.
